provenance: Curated from primary papers, official repositories, model hubs, project pages, and explicit licence or access terms. The 2026-10-10 local preview follows the September catalog with discovery lanes for all ten modalities, a calibrated-uncertainty lane and a candidate-feed/watchlist lane, followed by a separate adversarial review of every proposed addition and promotion. It adds 80 records, promotes 7 previously held records whose reconsideration conditions are now met, moves 1 record whose official code was withdrawn to the under-review register, corrects stale access, repository and publication details on existing records, and re-reviews every held record. The canonical displayed catalog contains 486 records; 37 unresolved candidates remain in the separate under-review register. Unchanged rows retain their prior verification dates. Generated distributions come from canonical JSON through a deterministic build. This preview has no published release reference.
evidence_statement: 486 records: 247 verified and 239 with visible limitations. October review covers new and promoted entries, targeted corrections and all previously held records; older verification dates are preserved. 37 candidates remain under review. Check each record's access and licence limitations before use.
